question: Can a trade offered before the deadline be accepted after it?
lead_md: Canon does not say whether a trade offered before the deadline can be accepted after it. More than one reading fits the text. The desk can't decide this for you.

branches.label: Reading 1: the offer time counts
branches.reading: A trade is valid if it was offered before the deadline, even when it is accepted later.

rule.claim: Trades must be completed before the trade deadline.

branches.needs: A rule that ties validity to the offer.

branches.label: Reading 2: the accept time counts
branches.reading: A trade is valid only if it is accepted before the deadline.

rule.claim: The salary cap is checked at the moment of the accept.

branches.needs: A note that the accept is the completing event.

cites.claim: Trades must be completed before the trade deadline.
The salary cap is checked at the moment of the accept.

ruling_question: If a trade is offered before the trade deadline but accepted after it, is it valid? Should the offer time or the accept time decide?
follow_ups: Show past trades accepted after a deadline
